over.metaBeschrijving: Autofiscaliteit was built by Sami Elhamdaoui, grew out of his final-year project and his internship at B-sure, and is maintained by Ekoon ICT. Free for every Belgian company.
over.heroTekst: Autofiscaliteit started as the practical half of my final-year project on the impact of car costs on disallowed expenses, written during my internship at B-sure. What began as a calculation for the files that crossed my desk there is now online, free, for every company in Belgium.
over.herkomstNaam: An internship and a final-year project
over.verhaal1: During my internship at B-sure I worked in the accounting and finance department. That is where a company's numbers show up in their most concrete form: invoices, depreciation, payslips, tax returns. And the same question kept surfacing, usually asked almost in passing: which car should we actually buy or lease?
over.verhaal2: An answer was rarely at hand. On the table were quotes with a monthly amount, and that monthly amount is precisely the one part of the cost nobody needs to calculate. The rest is scattered: part of it in corporate tax through the deduction limit, part on the director's payslip through the benefit in kind, part at the social security office through the solidarity contribution, and part again in the disallowed expenses that push taxable profit back up. Four places, four formulas, and not one document that brings them together.
over.verhaal3: The timing sharpens it. A large share of Belgian company fleets comes up for renewal between 2026 and 2028, exactly when the rules change fundamentally. From 2026 the corporate tax deductibility of new combustion cars drops to zero, while electric cars ordered before 2027 keep their full deduction. At the same time the CO₂ solidarity contribution and the minimum director's salary for the reduced SME rate both rise. Deciding by gut feeling easily costs thousands, and you only notice two tax returns later.
over.verhaal4: For my final-year project I wrote that calculation out in full and then turned it into a tool: the deduction calendar per ordering period, the gram formula for older orders, the benefit in kind with its age correction and legal minimum, the disallowed expenses with and without a fuel or charging card, and the social security contribution with its indexation coefficient. All of it in a single calculation, per year of use, with a reasoned recommendation instead of a hunch.
over.verhaal5: A final-year project normally disappears into a drawer. This one seemed too useful for that, so it became a public web application: in Dutch, French and English, free, with no limit on the number of vehicles. The calculation core is tested separately against a fully worked reference case, and the tax parameters are reviewed and updated every year after the federal budget agreement.
over.citaat: The monthly amount on a leasing quote is the one part of the cost you never have to work out. That is exactly why it is printed so large.
over.lijnIntro: How a question that kept coming back at the office grew into an application anyone can use.
over.lijn1Tekst: In the accounting and finance department the choice of car kept coming back, with no single document showing the full cost.
over.lijn2Tekst: The legislation, the circulars and the social security instructions picked apart and reassembled into one coherent calculation of the real cost.
over.lijn3Tekst: The calculation rebuilt into an application with a catalogue, your own fleet, comparison and decision history, in three languages and free online.
over.lijn4Tekst: Parameters are updated every year after the budget agreement, and what users report helps decide what gets built next.
over.gratis1: The figures this tool works with are public: they are in the law, in circulars and in the social security instructions. What was missing was not the information, but the patience to put it together correctly.
over.gratis2: A small business rarely has an adviser for this, and often ends up paying the most as a result. That is why Autofiscaliteit is free, with no limit on the number of vehicles and no paid tier. If you find it useful, feel free to pass it on.
over.gratis3: What it costs to keep the site running, I pay myself. If the tool is useful to you, you can <steunen>contribute voluntarily</steunen>. If you do not, you miss nothing: there will be no paid tier, no advertising and no limits.

privacy.metaBeschrijving: What data Autofiscaliteit processes, why, where it is stored and how to have it deleted.
privacy.intro: Autofiscaliteit processes as little personal data as possible. Here is exactly what, why, and what your rights are.
privacy.verantwoordelijk: Autofiscaliteit is published by Sami Elhamdaoui, Belgium. For anything to do with your data, you can reach us at <mail></mail>.
privacy.rollenTitel: Two kinds of data, two roles
privacy.rollen1: The distinction matters for your rights, which is why it comes first.
privacy.rollen2: Your account details (your email address, your name, your company name and optionally your company number) we process as data controller. Without them you cannot sign in and we cannot tell your company apart from any other.
privacy.rollen3: The data you enter about your fleet we process as data processor, on behalf of your company. Your company decides what is entered and remains responsible for it. We use that data solely to show the calculation to the users of your company, never for anything else, and never to pass it on to third parties.
privacy.minimaTitel: A note on employee names and number plates
privacy.minima1: The vehicle form has an employee field and a number plate field. Both are personal data, and both are entirely optional: the calculation works exactly the same if you leave them empty or enter an internal code such as “car 3”.
privacy.minima2: Our recommendation is therefore not to fill them in. Not collecting personal data is simpler than protecting it.
privacy.welkeAccount: Account: email address, name, password (stored encrypted; we cannot read it).
privacy.welkeBedrijf: Company: company name, optionally the company number, and which users belong to it.
privacy.welkeWagens: Fleet: the technical and financial details you enter yourself, plus the optional fields above.
privacy.welkeEvaluaties: Saved comparisons: the title, the note and the outcome of decisions you save.
privacy.welkeTechnisch: Technical: the session cookie that keeps you signed in, and the standard server logs of our hosting providers.
privacy.waar1: The application runs on Vercel and the database on Supabase. We deliberately choose storage within the European Union. Both suppliers act as sub-processors and are contractually bound by the GDPR.
privacy.waar2: There are no other recipients. We do not sell data, we do not share it with advertisers, and there is no advertising or tracking network built into the application.
privacy.cookies: Autofiscaliteit sets only the cookies needed to keep you signed in. There are no analytics, advertising or tracking cookies. That is also why you see no cookie banner here: strictly necessary cookies do not require consent.
privacy.bewaartermijn: For as long as your account exists. If you delete your company, the company, all user accounts, all vehicles and all saved decisions are deleted immediately and permanently. Backups held by our suppliers disappear within thirty days.
privacy.rechten1: You have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict and port your data, and you can object to the processing.
privacy.rechten2: Two of those you can exercise straight away, without asking us: <instellingen>in your settings</instellingen> you change your company details and delete your company with all the data in it. For the rest, a message is enough.
privacy.rechten3: If you disagree with how we handle your data, you can lodge a complaint with the Belgian Data Protection Authority, Drukpersstraat 35, 1000 Brussels.
privacy.beveiliging1: Each company sees only its own data. That separation does not live in the website but in the database itself: every query there is constrained to the company from your session. Traffic runs exclusively over HTTPS and passwords are stored hashed.
privacy.beveiliging2: If you do spot a security problem, please let us know before making it public. We will be grateful.

voorwaarden.metaBeschrijving: The rules around using Autofiscaliteit: free, without warranty, and not a substitute for tax advice.
voorwaarden.intro: Short and to the point: what you may expect from Autofiscaliteit, and what you may not.
voorwaarden.geenAdvies1: Autofiscaliteit is a calculator. It applies the tax rules to the figures you enter and shows the result. It does not know your situation: not your corporate structure, not your existing agreements with the leasing company, not the exceptions that may apply to you.
voorwaarden.geenAdvies2: Do not take a purchase or lease decision on the basis of this tool alone. Put the result to your accountant or tax adviser.
voorwaarden.gratis1: Use is free of charge and there is no paid version. In return, the service is provided “as is”: we promise no uninterrupted availability, no retention period and no support within any set timeframe.
voorwaarden.gratis2: The service may be changed or discontinued. If that happens, we notify registered users in advance by email so you can take your data with you.
voorwaarden.cijfers1: The tax parameters follow federal legislation as it stood at the last update, viewable on the <parameters>parameters</parameters> page. Legislation changes, sometimes retroactively. For an important decision, always check that the figures used are still current.
voorwaarden.cijfers2: The catalogue values and CO₂ figures in the vehicle catalogue are indicative benchmarks that vary by trim and options. For a real decision, use the figures from your own quotation.
voorwaarden.account1: You are responsible for your password and for whom you invite into your company. Anyone you invite sees all vehicles and decisions belonging to your company.
voorwaarden.account2: Only enter data you are entitled to hold. If you enter personal data about employees, that is your choice and your responsibility: it is not needed for the calculation.
voorwaarden.account3: No automated scraping of the site, and no attempts to circumvent the separation between companies.
voorwaarden.verwerker: If you enter data relating to identifiable people, we act in that respect as processor on your instructions. We process that data solely to provide the service to you, do not pass it to any third party other than our hosting providers within the EU, and delete it as soon as you delete your company. This clause serves as a data processing agreement within the meaning of Article 28 GDPR. The details are in the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.
voorwaarden.aansprakelijkheid1: For a free service, our liability is limited to what Belgian law allows. We are not liable for decisions you take on the basis of the calculation, nor for consequential loss such as missed savings or additional tax.
voorwaarden.aansprakelijkheid2: What we do not exclude, because the law does not permit it: liability for fraud, wilful misconduct and gross negligence, and for harm to life or health.
voorwaarden.recht: These terms are governed by Belgian law. Disputes are settled by the competent courts in Belgium.

fiscaalKader.metaBeschrijving: The four elements that determine the tax impact of a company car in Belgium: deductibility, benefit in kind, CO₂ contribution and total cost of ownership.
fiscaalKader.kop: The taxation of the company car
fiscaalKader.intro: Four elements together determine the tax impact of a company car: deductibility for the employer, the benefit in kind for the employee, the CO₂ solidarity contribution and the total cost of ownership. Below is the framework our calculation applies.
fiscaalKader.aftrekTekst: How far the costs of the car are deductible depends on the drivetrain and the CO₂ emissions. Fully electric cars remain the most favourable, while the deduction for combustion-engine cars is being phased out step by step (ordered from 2026: 0%).
fiscaalKader.aftrekVoetnoot: The percentages are indicative. The exact deduction follows from the gram formula and the order year; our calculation engine is authoritative here.
fiscaalKader.vaaTekst: An employee who also uses the car privately is taxed on a benefit in kind (VAA/ATN). It is calculated from the catalogue value, a CO₂ coefficient and an age correction, with a statutory minimum of €1,690 (2026).
fiscaalKader.vaaCatalogus: The as-new value including options and VAT, before discounts.
fiscaalKader.vaaCo2: Rises with emissions, starting from a reference emission that is adjusted each year (2026: 70 g petrol, 58 g diesel).
fiscaalKader.vaaLeeftijd: The catalogue value drops by 6% for each year started, down to a floor of 70%.
fiscaalKader.co2Tekst: On top of the restricted deduction, the employer pays a monthly solidarity contribution to the social security office. It rises with CO₂ emissions (fuel constant: diesel 600, petrol 768, LPG 990) and, for non-electric cars ordered from 1 July 2023, is increased by a multiplier that grows each contribution year (×4 in 2026, ×5.5 from 2027). Fully electric cars fall under the lower base minimum (€33.93 per month in 2026).
fiscaalKader.tcoTekst: The total cost of ownership brings all the elements together: the annual car costs, the non-deductible component (additional corporate tax) and the CO₂ contribution. It is this figure that makes a fair comparison between cars possible.
fiscaalKader.tcoKaderTitel: Why total cost of ownership decides it
fiscaalKader.tcoKader: A lower list price does not automatically mean a lower cost. An electric car with a higher purchase price can still work out cheaper thanks to the full deduction, the low benefit in kind and the low social security contribution.

handleiding.metaBeschrijving: A practical five-step guide: from quotation to a well-founded decision on your company car.
handleiding.intro: A practical guide in five steps, from quotation to a well-founded decision. No prior tax knowledge needed: the tool does all the calculating for you.
handleiding.stap1Tekst: Open ‘Catalogue’. You will see the most common company cars in Belgium, each with its 2026 tax impact right away: tax deduction, benefit in kind, disallowed expenses and CO₂. Use the search bar or the filter chips (electric, plug-in hybrid, hybrid, diesel/petrol) to narrow things down.
handleiding.stap2Tekst: Click ‘Add to comparison’ on a card. A bar appears at the bottom with your selection and a ‘Go to comparison’ button. Have a specific quotation? Enter it under ‘Vehicles’: fill in make, price, CO₂ and policy (fuel/charge card, home charging point) and see the live tax estimate immediately.
handleiding.stap3Tekst: Go to ‘Comparison’ and pick up to three candidates using the chips at the top. You can set the first year of use and switch on the reduced SME rate. The tool shows the winner banner, a key-figures table marking the most favourable value per criterion, the scoring matrix with six weighted criteria and a chart (total cost, benefit in kind or deduction).
handleiding.stap4Tekst: Every candidate gets a final score out of 10 and a recommendation: accept (≥ 7), consider (4 to 7) or reject (< 4). Give the comparison a title and a short rationale, then click ‘Save decision’; it goes into the decision history. With ‘Print / PDF’ you can take the recommendation into the board meeting.
handleiding.stap5Tekst: The ‘Parameters’ page lists the tax values used in the calculation: minimum benefit in kind, reference CO₂, social security index and multiplier, and the full deduction calendar. They apply across Belgium and are updated centrally after the federal budget agreement.
handleiding.woordenlijstIntro: The terms you come across in the tool, explained briefly.
handleiding.uitlegVaa: The taxable value of an employee's private use of a company car.
handleiding.uitlegVu: Costs the company books but may not (fully) deduct for tax purposes; they increase taxable profit.
handleiding.uitlegAftrek: The percentage of car costs that is deductible for corporate income tax.
handleiding.uitlegRsz: Monthly solidarity contribution the employer pays for each car with private use.
handleiding.uitlegTco: Total cost of ownership: the full cost of use over the term (four years here).
handleiding.uitlegUitdoof: The tapering path along which the deduction for fossil-fuel cars and plug-in hybrids falls to 0%.
handleiding.meerAchtergrond: More background and the full formulas are on the <kader>Tax framework</kader> page.
handleiding.hulpTitel: A question, a mistake or an idea?
handleiding.hulpTekst: Is something not working, or does a figure not match your tax return? Send it to <mail></mail>, ideally with the car and the year of use. The tool itself stays free; the hosting is something you may voluntarily chip in for.

dashboard.intro: Autofiscaliteit works out the full tax bill of a company car: deductibility, benefit in kind, disallowed expenses and the CO₂ contribution to social security. For one car or for your whole fleet.
dashboard.kpiVensterDetail: Last year in which an ordered combustion car is still partly deductible.
dashboard.zoWerktKop: Three steps to a well-founded choice
dashboard.zoWerktIntro: You supply the cars. We work through the tax consequences. Together you choose with confidence.
dashboard.stap1Tekst: You enter the cars you are considering, or pick them straight from our catalogue.
dashboard.stap2Tekst: The tax deduction, the benefit in kind, the disallowed expenses and the social security contribution are all worked through precisely.
dashboard.stap3Tekst: You see the winner at a glance, with clear reasoning per weighted criterion.
dashboard.slotKop: Know what a car really costs, before you sign
dashboard.slotTekst: Work a candidate through in full in the simulator. To put several cars side by side, track your fleet and keep your decision, create a free account.
dashboard.introTwee: Enter a car or pick one from the catalogue of 163 models. You immediately see what it costs per year, how that develops up to 2031, and how it stacks up against the alternatives.
dashboard.watKop: What you can do with Autofiscaliteit
dashboard.watIntro: Six parts, from a quick calculation for a single car to managing an entire fleet. Start wherever you like.
dashboard.featSimulatorTekst: Pick a model, adjust the costs and see the deduction percentage, the benefit in kind, the disallowed expenses and the total annual cost straight away. No account needed.
dashboard.featCatalogusTekst: Electric, hybrid and combustion, with consumption, range, boot volume and towing capacity. Filter by make, body style or drivetrain and see the tax consequences per model.
dashboard.featVergelijkingTekst: Seven weighted criteria, from four-year cost to practical usefulness, with a chart and a verdict of accept, consider or reject. Every decision is kept.
dashboard.featVlootTekst: See per car when the deduction drops and what that costs, with a replacement calendar towards 2028. Necessary, because a car that is still deductible today will not be in two years.
dashboard.featModellenTekst: Is your version missing from the catalogue? Add it yourself or import it from a CSV file. It stays with your company and calculates like any other model.
dashboard.featKaderTekst: Every parameter is open: reference CO₂, minimum benefit in kind, social security index, regional rates and charging rates. Each figure carries its legal source and how firm it is.
dashboard.berekentIntro: The tax cost of a car is not one number but a stack of levies that each follow their own rules. This is what the calculation engine works through.
dashboard.rekenAftrekTekst: The gram formula, the phase-out calendar and the taper for electric cars, all hanging on the date of your order form.
dashboard.rekenVaaTekst: List price, age and CO₂ percentage, with the statutory minimum and the employee's own contribution built in.
dashboard.rekenVuTekst: The non-deductible share of the costs plus 17% or 40% of the benefit, depending on whether you provide a fuel or charge card.
dashboard.rekenRszTekst: The monthly employer contribution to social security, with the indexation coefficient and the multiplier that climbs by order year.
dashboard.rekenBtwTekst: The 35% flat rate or actual business use, always capped at the statutory half.
dashboard.rekenGewestTekst: The regional levies for Flanders, Wallonia and Brussels, flagging where a scale has never been officially published.
dashboard.rekenLadenTekst: The cost deduction on a charge point, the investment deduction and the amount you may reimburse tax free under the CREG rate.
dashboard.rekenHybrideTekst: Too little battery per hundred kilograms or too many emissions, and your plug-in hybrid is taxed like a combustion car.
dashboard.omslagKop: Why your order date now decides everything
dashboard.omslagIntro: Deductibility does not depend on when you drive but on when you sign. The percentage tied to your order period stays with the car for its whole life, so a signature one month late costs you years. Below, per order period, what electric and combustion each yield.
dashboard.omslagWaarschuwing: What counts is the date on the order form or lease contract, not the day the car is delivered. Keep that document: it is the only proof of your regime.
dashboard.uitgelichtIntro: Three models from the catalogue, with the real 2026 figures underneath. Click through for the full list with filters.
dashboard.vraagGratisAntwoord: Yes. Every part is free, with no trial period and no limit on the number of cars. There is a page where you can contribute voluntarily, but nothing sits behind a paywall.
dashboard.vraagAccountAntwoord: Not to calculate. The simulator and the catalogue work right away. A free account is only needed to save cars, put candidates side by side and track your fleet.
dashboard.vraagCijfersVraag: Where do the figures come from?
dashboard.vraagCijfersAntwoord: The tax parameters come from the Belgian official gazette and the circulars of the federal finance service, and are open on the parameters page with the legal source for each figure. Where a figure comes from a secondary source or is not yet final, that is stated explicitly.
dashboard.vraagAdviesVraag: Can I base my decision on this?
dashboard.vraagAdviesAntwoord: As a starting point yes, as an end point no. The calculation is informative and not tax advice. For a concrete file your bookkeeper or a certified accountant should still look at it, certainly with light commercial vehicles, foreign plates or split financial years.
dashboard.vraagGegevensAntwoord: Your cars and decisions are strictly walled off per company, enforced in the database itself and not just in the web page. Anyone calculating without an account leaves nothing behind at all: that calculation happens in your browser.
dashboard.uitgelichtLeegTekst: The highlighted models could not be loaded. Try again shortly, or open the catalogue directly.
dashboard.omslagNaarKader: How these percentages are arrived at

catalogus.kop: The fleet, weighed up for tax
catalogus.intro: The most common company cars in Belgium. Every car shows its key tax figures for 2026 straight away. Add models to compare them.
catalogus.metaBeschrijving: The most common company cars in Belgium, each with its key tax figures: deduction, benefit in kind, disallowed expenses and CO₂.
catalogus.aantalToegevoegd: {aantal, plural, =1 {# car added} other {# cars added}}
catalogus.geenResultatenTekst: No model matches this combination of search term and filters. Widen the selection, or clear the filters.
catalogus.zekerheidUitleg: For {geverifieerd} of the {totaal} models, the figures that drive the tax result were checked against a named source: the catalogue value for an electric car, the CO₂ for a plug-in hybrid. The rest are estimates: the right order of magnitude, but checked by no one.
catalogus.voorbehoud_teslaModelY: The WLTP consumption and range do not add up (629 km at 15.9 kWh/100 km implies roughly 100 kWh, against 75 kWh usable). The Belgian configurator also offers a Standard Long Range RWD. Use the certificate of conformity of the exact version.
catalogus.voorbehoud_audiQ4Facelift: After the 2026 facelift this version is called "45 performance" and the battery pack changed. The price is that of the 82 kWh version.
catalogus.voorbehoud_bmwI4Btw: The price is derived from the fiscal price list excluding VAT (€50,247.93 × 1.21) and should be confirmed.
catalogus.voorbehoud_buitenlandseBron: The figures come from a foreign manufacturer site. CO₂, consumption and price differ per Belgian version; have them replaced by a Belgian source.
catalogus.voorbehoud_valseHybrideGrensgeval: Borderline case for the false-hybrid test: the CO₂ sits around the threshold of 75 g/km (Euro 6e-bis) or 50 g/km (older homologation). Which regime applies turns on the exact value in the certificate of conformity.
catalogus.voorbehoud_bmw530eGeneratie: The figures come from the Belgian fiscal price list and describe the older G30 generation, not the current G60.
catalogus.voorbehoud_prijsNietGesourcet: The specifications were checked, the catalogue value was not. For an electric car the entire tax calculation hangs on that value.
catalogus.voorbehoud_bmwIx1Uitvoering: Only xDrive30 data was found; the eDrive20 is unconfirmed.
catalogus.voorbehoud_bmwIx3Generatie: The Belgian price list shows the old G08; the Neue Klasse figures are unconfirmed.
catalogus.voorbehoud_bmwX5Ontbreekt: The xDrive50e does not appear in the Belgian price list consulted, only the older xDrive45e.
catalogus.voorbehoud_co2NietGevonden: No homologated CO₂ figure found for the Belgian version. For a plug-in hybrid that figure is exactly what determines the benefit in kind and the contribution.
catalogus.restwaardeSchatting: The residual value is an estimate per drivetrain, not per model: a recognised Belgian per-model figure does not exist.

parameters.metaBeschrijving: The tax parameters Autofiscaliteit calculates with, per calendar year: minimum benefit in kind, reference CO₂, social security index and the full deduction calendar.
parameters.intro: The figures Autofiscaliteit calculates with, per calendar year. They apply across Belgium and are updated centrally after the federal budget agreement, which is why they cannot be adjusted per company.
parameters.multiplicatorTitel: Social security multiplier per order period
parameters.multiplicatorIntro: The solidarity contribution for non-electric cars increases depending on the period in which the car was ordered.
parameters.kalenderIntro: Corporate tax deductibility per drivetrain and order period. “Whole period of use” applies to every year of use; orders placed before 1 July 2023 automatically follow the gram formula.
parameters.voetnoot: These figures reflect federal legislation as known at the last update. They do not constitute tax advice: check every decision with your accountant or tax adviser.
parameters.veldVuMetKaart: Benefit in kind → disallowed, with fuel/charge card
parameters.veldVuZonderKaart: Benefit in kind → disallowed, without card
parameters.beheerIntro: To be updated each year after the federal budget agreement. Changes apply immediately to the calculations of every user.
parameters.beheerNietGeladen: The tax parameters could not be loaded from the database. The form stays closed: saving would overwrite the published figures with the source-code defaults. Try again once the connection is back.
parameters.beheerBevestig: Reset all parameters and the deduction calendar to the published values?
parameters.geenToegangTekst: This page is reserved for the administration of Autofiscaliteit. The tax parameters apply across Belgium and cannot be adjusted per company.
parameters.gewestIntro: Registration tax and annual road tax are regional matters. The rates below are the ones published as an amount. The full scales by fiscal horsepower and engine capacity are deliberately absent: they were never published as a table, and the calculation engine therefore returns no amount for them.
parameters.gewestVoetnoot: For a binding amount, use the region's own simulator: VLABEL for Flanders, SPW Fiscalité for Wallonia and Brussels Fiscality for the Brussels Region.
parameters.regelBivEvVlaanderen: Registration tax, electric, Flanders, registered from 2026
parameters.regelBivEvBrussel: Registration tax, electric, Brussels, minimum rate
parameters.regelTmcGrenzen: Registration tax Wallonia, floor and ceiling
parameters.regelJvbEvVlaanderen: Road tax, electric, Flanders, 1 to 5 fiscal horsepower
parameters.regelJvbMinVlaanderen: Minimum road tax Flanders, municipal surcharge included
parameters.regelJvbMinWalBru: Minimum road tax Wallonia and Brussels
parameters.regelCorrectiefactor: Technological correction factor, registration tax Flanders 2026
parameters.regelOpdeciem: Municipal surcharge on Flemish road tax
parameters.cregIntro: The maximum per kWh an employer may reimburse tax free for electricity the employee charges at home. CREG publishes it per quarter and per region. Reimbursing more turns the difference into taxable pay.
parameters.vergoedingIntro: The kilometre allowance for business travel in a private car, plus the amounts that surround the car without being a car cost.
parameters.aangekondigdIntro: None of the following has been decided or confirmed. It is here because it affects a decision made today, and kept separate because no budget should rely on it.
parameters.hervormingPunt1: The basis becomes maximum authorised mass plus CO2 emissions, instead of fiscal horsepower.
parameters.hervormingPunt2: An increasing factor for engines from 2,400 cc and for diesels below Euro 6.
parameters.hervormingPunt3: Existing vehicles choose between the old and the new system, the new one only where it works out cheaper.
parameters.hervormingPunt4: Leased cars stay on fiscal horsepower.
parameters.hervormingPunt5: The increase is capped at 125 euro per year.
parameters.zekerheidIntro: Not every figure in Belgian car taxation is equally solid. An amount from the official gazette and an amount from a press release should not read the same way, which is why every figure here carries its origin.
parameters.zekerheidUitleg_bevestigd: Published in the Belgian official gazette or on the website of the competent administration.
parameters.zekerheidUitleg_teVerifieren: From a secondary source. Usable as an estimate, to be checked with VLABEL, the federal service or the social security office for a binding amount.
parameters.zekerheidUitleg_voorlopig: Announced or leaked, not yet decided. May still change before it takes effect.

wagens.intro: Identification, technical details, finances and policy per vehicle. Calculated figures apply to year of use 2026.
wagens.snelStarten: Quick start: pick a model from the catalogue (pre-fills the fields)
wagens.interneReferentieHint: Optional. A name is not needed for the calculation: a code such as “car 3” is enough.
wagens.kentekenHint: Optional. Plays no part in the calculation.
wagens.tankkaart: Fuel/charge card (40% benefit in kind → disallowed)
wagens.vulVeldenIn: Fill in the fields to see the estimate.
wagens.verwijderBevestig: This vehicle disappears from your fleet, together with the calculations on it. This cannot be undone.
wagens.leeg: No vehicles yet. Add some from the catalogue or via “New vehicle”.
wagens.verfijningTitel: Refinement: VAT, financing and employee contribution
wagens.verfijningIntro: Optional. Filling this in gives a noticeably more accurate picture: recovered VAT and the interest inside the lease price both reduce disallowed expenses.
wagens.btwMethodeHint: The deduction is legally capped at 50%, and never more than actual business use.
wagens.kostenFinancieringHint: Financing costs fall outside the deduction limit and stay fully deductible.
wagens.eigenBijdrageHint: Reduces the benefit in kind, and with it the disallowed expenses.
wagens.laadpaalJaarkostHint: Falls outside the deduction limit that applies to cars.
wagens.laadstroomJaarHint: Follows the deductibility of the car itself.
wagens.kostenBoetesHint: Never deductible, not even partly. They go into disallowed expenses in full.
wagens.euronormHint: Shown on the certificate of conformity. Drives the air component of the registration tax and low emission zone access.
wagens.gewestHint: Determines which registration tax and which road tax apply.
wagens.phevIntro: A plug-in hybrid with too little battery per hundred kilograms, or with emissions that are too high, is treated as a combustion car for tax purposes. The calculation then uses the emissions of the matching model without a plug, and failing that the official figure times 2.5.
wagens.batterijKwhHint: Energy capacity, not the usable share. Needed for the 0.5 kWh per 100 kg test.
wagens.wagengewichtHint: The weight used to work out capacity per hundred kilograms.
wagens.co2Equivalent: CO₂ of the model without a plug
wagens.co2EquivalentHint: Emissions of the matching non plug-in model, where one exists. Leave empty to apply the factor 2.5.
wagens.kostenBrandstofHint: The fuel share within the car costs. Capped at 50% deduction, and nil from 2028.
wagens.hybrideReden_geenPhev: Not a plug-in hybrid, the rule does not apply here.
wagens.hybrideReden_bovenDrempel: Fake hybrid: {co2} g/km is above the threshold of {drempel} g/km.
wagens.hybrideReden_teKleineBatterij: Fake hybrid: the battery delivers {kwh} kWh per 100 kg, less than the required {minimum}.
wagens.hybrideReden_geenBatterijgegevens: Emissions stay below {drempel} g/km. The battery test was not run: fill in capacity and weight to be sure.
wagens.hybrideReden_echteHybride: Genuine plug-in hybrid: below {drempel} g/km and at least {minimum} kWh per 100 kg.

vergelijking.intro: A well-founded ranking based on tax deduction, benefit in kind, total cost and environmental impact.
vergelijking.selecteerKandidaat: Select at least one candidate to see the comparison.

vergelijking.kerncijfersTitel: Key tax figures side by side
vergelijking.disclaimer: This calculation is a tool, not tax advice. It does not account for the regional registration tax and road tax, nor for the specifics of your situation. Discuss every decision with your accountant or tax adviser.
vergelijking.gekleurdeBalk: The coloured bar marks the most favourable value.
vergelijking.bewarenIntro: Record this comparison for the board meeting.
vergelijking.critTcoUitleg: Total cost over 4 years of use (car costs + additional corporate tax + social security contribution), relative to the cheapest candidate.
vergelijking.critAftrekUitleg: Average tax deductibility over 4 years of use.
vergelijking.critVuUitleg: Average disallowed expenses relative to the annual car costs.
vergelijking.critFlexUitleg: Range, charging time and charging network; manual score per vehicle.
vergelijking.critCo2Uitleg: Score based on the vehicle's CO₂ emissions.
vergelijking.critRestUitleg: Expected residual value after four years; manual score per vehicle.

modellen.uitrustingHint: Comma separated, for example: heat pump, tow bar.
modellen.bronHint: Where these figures come from, so they can be checked later.

kosten.voorbehoud_bevVlaanderen: Flanders: the exemption for new electric cars ended for registrations from 1 January 2026. The published range is €69.72 to €87.24 per year depending on fiscal horsepower (for an electric car: 0.013 × kW + 0.5, rounded, at most 5), plus a registration tax of €61.50. The calculation uses €87.24, the upper bound.
kosten.voorbehoud_bevWallonieBrussel: Wallonia and Brussels: the sources contradict each other. carvex.be states that electric cars pay no road tax there; FLEET.be explicitly mentions the minimum rate of €102.96 per year (rate 1 July 2025 – 30 June 2026). The calculation uses €102.96, the higher amount. Over four years that is more than €400 of difference: have it confirmed by SPW Finances or Brussels Fiscality before relying on it.
